cause: A single unsupported scene path or spatial part disabled the compiled deformation evaluator for the whole document. The fortune model therefore repeatedly sampled parent-space grids through the general evaluator, with additional transient coordinate allocations.
changes: Compile supported ancestor paths independently; retain the general evaluator for special paths.
Reuse coordinate buffers for document-space grids while preserving local-before-parent evaluation order.
Skip geometry evaluation for branches without requested vertex buffers while retaining complete skinning frames.
Include coordinate space in shared-transform keys.
preserved: All model file bytes, textures, meshes, bindings, physics, motions and rendering options.
Unrounded coordinate arithmetic and general evaluation for spatial, curved and vertex-dependent paths.
note: Profile captures demonstrate the cause and intermediate optimized path. The final benchmark is a separate unprofiled alternating run in one browser, after formatting and other checks completed.
